apiError.schedule_kind_invalid: Choose one of once, interval, daily or weekly.
apiError.schedule_content_invalid: The instructions are required and too long ones are rejected.
apiError.schedule_run_at_required: Set a run time for a one-time schedule.

apiError.schedule_run_at_past: The run time must be in the future.
apiError.schedule_interval_invalid: The interval must be between 1 minute and 365 days.
apiError.schedule_time_invalid: The time of day must be HH:MM.
apiError.schedule_weekdays_invalid: Pick at least one valid day of the week.
apiError.schedule_timing_conflict: Those timing fields don't belong to this kind of schedule.
apiError.schedule_timing_locked: A one-time schedule that has already run can't be rescheduled.
apiError.proxy_challenge: Your site's protection (Cloudflare) needs a quick re-check.
apiError.csrf: The request was blocked as a cross-site request. Reload the page and try again.
apiError.plugin_busy: The plugin is in use by a task. Try again shortly.
apiError.computer_busy: The Bot computer is busy or controlled by another window, task or Bot. Stop the current task or try again shortly.
apiError.control_expired: Control was released or expired. Take over again.
apiError.input_sequence: The input sequence is stale. Take over again.
apiError.control_unavailable: Desktop control is unavailable. Take over again.
apiError.ssh_key_format: Check the key file name and content format.
apiError.dictation_unconfigured: Connect Codex, add an OpenAI API key, or configure a server transcription API key.
apiError.dictation_auth_unavailable: Transcription authentication is unavailable. Try again or reconnect Codex.
apiError.oauth_https_required: Web authorization requires HTTPS. Over plain HTTP, authorize from the Bot computer or use HTTPS or the Tofi client.
apiError.draft_conflict: The draft has changed. Refresh to see the latest.
apiError.draft_invalid: Recipients, subject and body must be valid.
apiError.recipient_limit: A draft takes at most 20 recipients.
apiError.recipient_invalid: A recipient email address is invalid.
apiError.gmail_permission: Connect Google in Settings and allow reading and sending first.
apiError.send_unknown: The send result is unconfirmed. Check the Gmail sent folder before deciding what to do next; the system will not resend automatically.
apiError.model_unavailable: Connect a model before running work items.
apiError.confirmation_required: Confirm restarting the Bot computer; all desktops and terminals will disconnect.
apiError.restart_unavailable: The Bot computer cannot restart right now. Try again shortly.
apiError.work_stop_first: Stop this work item's execution before editing it or marking it done.
apiError.work_execution_superseded: The work item was run again, finished or reassigned. Check the board for the current task.
apiError.work_needs_origin_conversation: Run the work item in its original, user-visible conversation.
apiError.work_goal_is_planning: This goal is for planning. Pick a work item to start.
apiError.work_reopen_first: Reopen this finished work item first.
apiError.work_already_running: This work item already has a task running. Wait for it to finish or stop it.
apiError.work_conversation_busy: This conversation still has a task running or waiting on collaborators. Wait for it to finish or stop the round.
apiError.work_no_result: The round ended without a reviewable result in the original conversation.
apiError.work_result_attachments: The result includes attachments. See the original conversation.
apiError.work_collaboration_incomplete: Collaborative execution did not finish. Check progress in the original conversation, or stop the round and retry.
apiError.collaborator_incomplete: A collaborator did not finish this step.
apiError.vm_oauth_start_failed: Could not start authorization. Try again.
apiError.vm_oauth_computer_lost: The Bot computer connection was lost. Authorize again.
apiError.vm_oauth_exchange_failed: Authorization exchange failed. Check the service's callback configuration and try again.
apiError.vm_oauth_denied: Authorization was not granted. You can connect again.
apiError.unsupported_transport: This service uses legacy MCP SSE, which cannot support 2026-07-28. Upgrade the service and switch it to Streamable HTTP.
apiError.unsupported_protocol: This MCP service does not support the 2026-07-28 protocol that Tofi requires. Upgrade the service; Tofi does not fall back to an older protocol.
apiError.api_disabled: Google reports the API is not enabled. Enable the product API and its MCP service in the same project as the OAuth client, then refresh the tools.
apiError.access_denied: Google denied access. If the app is in testing mode, check that this account is a test user; an account or organization restriction is also possible.
apiError.permission_denied: Google refused to list the tools. Confirm the Cloud project has joined the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, that the OAuth client has "Use this client for an AI-powered agent" checked (from 2026-11-11 the Workspace MCP rejects unmarked clients; the setting is fixed after 11-12, so a new client is needed), and check the API and MCP enablement and the account's permissions. A 401 or 403 alone cannot tell which one it is.
apiError.context_snapshot_unavailable: No context was recorded for this reply.
apiError.oauth_loopback_only: This connection signs in only through a 127.0.0.1 redirect: on the Bot computer or by paste-back.
apiError.oauth_paste_invalid: That is not the redirect this sign-in expects. Paste the full address from the address bar.
apiError.oauth_paste_not_needed: This connection does not use paste-back sign-in.
apiError.oauth_issuer_mismatch: That response did not come from the expected authorization server. Connect again.
apiError.oauth_loopback_required: This service accepts only a 127.0.0.1 redirect. Sign in with the paste-back step.
apiError.skill_exists: A Skill or bundle with that name is already in the library.
apiError.skill_in_bundle: This Skill belongs to a bundle. Remove the bundle instead.
apiError.skill_unchanged: Those files are the same as the current version.
apiError.update_not_available: That version isn't on offer any more. Reload and try again.
apiError.update_in_progress: An update is already in progress.
apiError.host_update_unavailable: This server can't update from the page yet. Run sudo tofi update on the server.
apiError.storage_quota_exceeded: This account's storage limit is reached. Delete files or ask the administrator.
apiError.storage_host_full: The server disk is almost full, so no new files are accepted. Tell the operator of this server.
apiError.update_check_failed: Couldn't reach the update server. Try again later.
